interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with curb extensions to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility between parked cars.

interventions.title: Bicycle Lane Installation
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for a dedicated bike lane to narrow travel lanes and encourage slower vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage and RRFBs
interventions.description: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs) and enhanced pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the mid-block crossing.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station curb cuts to slow turning vehicles and minimize the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the midblock crossing.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or tables to physically slow vehicle speeds in this school zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or a row of street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFB (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon) to facilitate safe crossing to the school.
